items.note: S2.4 states the signed exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with all scratch restored; S2.3 gives the net change (JV+RG)x independent of scratch, S2.4.1-2 the bit/complex coefficient cancellations and S2.4.3 the three-stage composition, as in lines 741-765. S2.5 states the common frame per gate, its commutation with pointwise gates and the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, quoting line 812. It is a single infer step without the invariant argument, and the route formula eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} appears only as applied in S2.10.3.2.

Only decreasing edges center 3->4 losing h, L=Ich, absolute sum Wm-2N+2L and the ratios 100/539, 101/539 are all stated correctly. S2.1 lists the four elementary O(V) operations and S2.2 the controlled shift and unit scaling, whose quoted support includes the b^{O(1)} offset condition. Both are infer steps without the split/merge derivations of 513-550 and 574-621.

E_1 Pi E_2 by pivoting on the topmost nonzero row's rightmost entry, linear-cost triangular transforms in descending order, the conjugation sequence and the one-interchange realisation of H_i<-H_i+D_j all follow 1375-1447. The choice of a fixed prime q avoiding the table's denominators (1413-1423) is left implicit.

These steps cover the cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, the Phi_{I_m} endpoint, the interchange D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D, exactly s recursive calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the a<=1 / a>1 case split, F_k=O(e^tau) and the depth-first parking schedule. All of it is the paper's route at 1491-1616.

These steps follow 1649-1734: high digits joined into a row field R=q^{2rho}>=W^k, padding to R'<2R, the base-m decomposition with a geometric sum and binary padding to [q^e]. Unequal widths (1740-1762) appear only as 'peeling one bit' in S5.5.4.

The sizes b, p=6b, d, K, T, r, t_i, the size consequences, the comparison constants, the prime intervals with eta=1/(4d), T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta_i>p, the trial-division cost and no wraparound are all correct. errors.says: Subtracting the effect of the unknown scratch contents, adding the real contribution and then undoing the first step changes the target by (JV+RG)x.
errors.paper: Rows 0-1 subtract Ja+Rc. Rows 2-3 load a+Vx, c+Gx. Rows 4-5 add R(c+Gx)+J(a+Vx). Rows 6-7 undo gather and copy to restore c,a. What is undone at the end is the loading of the scratch, not the initial subtraction.

errors.says: Giving each gate and terminal a nested nondegenerate subspace ..., the sum of edge dimension changes is Wm-2N+2L with L<N/2.
errors.paper: The signed sum of dimension changes is Wm-2N. Wm-2N+2L is the sum of absolute changes. Labels are only comparable along each edge, not one nested chain. S2.6.4 itself has it right.

errors.says: method: bound each edge's rank by its dimension change
errors.paper: For nested nondegenerate U in V, rank(P_V-P_U) equals dim V-dim U exactly. Equality is what gives the exact s_b; S2.7.1 states the equality.
The first scale multiplies by S and the second by 2^{2b+4}S. The two occurrences of S undo different normalisations. S6.10 and S6.12 state this correctly.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). It goes from the scalar network and frames through the label budget, the bit and complex interfaces with s<Wm, and tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}. From there it reaches the interchange and layer recurrences, then synthetic transforms, ring convolution, resampling and chirp, assembly, exact recovery and the kappa=2^{-182} margin. It thins out at the network's concrete parameters (h=100, N, m never defined) and the label construction (bilinear forms, neighbour orthogonality and residual tables absent). It also thins out in the parameter checks (alpha, gamma<=b/4, layer inequalities) and the o(V) setup and exceptional-sorting accounting.

steps.note: The fixed linear network exchanging banks indexed by triples, (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored, is present. h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never stated, and N and m are used undefined, so the step is only partly carried. The more conservative verdict is chosen.
Common invertible frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate, implementing D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, so that only edge frame changes cost.

These steps give nondegenerate subspace labels of an m-dimensional space built by tensoring triple indicator lines, comparable on edges, with only the center 3->4 edges decreasing, each by h. The bilinear forms are not given.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, with the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one as the exceptions.
This gives sum |Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and hence s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 and s<Wm.
The endpoint difference is P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m, with zero sources and identity sinks elsewhere, so the shear H<-H+D is applied on every role, scratch rows included.
The E_1 Pi E_2 factorisation gives exactly a interchanges plus O(V) per edge, so a node makes exactly s recursive calls.
Children of volume V/W give F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1). With eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, s/W<m^tau for tau=1-2^{-50}, and the geometric-sum case split gives F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving from frames through labels, rank equal to dimension change, the budget, the strict deficit L/N<1/2, the endpoint shear, edges as rank-many recursive calls and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The only weak link is the starting network: its bank exchange and scratch restoration are present, but h=100 and the definitions N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 behind the budget never appear.
